laws.behaviour: Dips a toe at the glass's foot, recoils, backs away and keeps its distance (wet ink runs)
laws.clause: walks to the foot of the glass, dips one toe at its edge, recoils as its wet ink starts to run, then backs away and keeps its distance
laws.label: Backed away from it

laws.behaviour: Walks up to the glass, rests its front feet against it, admires its reflection
laws.clause: walks up to the glass, rests its front feet against it and admires its own reflection in it
laws.label: Looked at its reflection

laws.behaviour: Leans against the glass, then softens and wilts as if damp
laws.clause: leans against the glass, then slowly softens and wilts as if damp
laws.label: Wilted

laws.behaviour: When the beam lands on it, ducks behind a small book standing on the desk
laws.clause: ducks behind the object standing upright on the desk beside it and hides there
laws.label: Hid from it

laws.behaviour: Walks to the uncapped nib and drinks; its lines grow bolder
laws.clause: walks to the uncapped nib and drinks from it, and its lines grow bolder
laws.label: Drank from it

laws.behaviour: Braces; its lines shiver like wet ink in wind, then settle
laws.clause: braces itself, and its lines shiver like wet ink in the wind, then settle
laws.label: Shivered

laws.behaviour: Reads the note and does what it says: jumps onto the note
laws.clause: reads the note and does what it says: it jumps onto the note
laws.label: Did what it said

laws.behaviour: Climbs onto the offered palm and sits
laws.clause: climbs onto the offered palm and sits down in it
laws.label: Climbed onto it

gold.look: a flat drawing in gold paint, never shaded or 3D

ink.look: a flat black ink line drawing, never shaded or 3D

paper.look: a flat cut-paper figure, never shaded or 3D
